reviews_verbatim.author: Diana Topping
reviews_verbatim.quote: From the initial consultation to the final installation, their team displayed professionalism and expertise. The quality of their work exceeded my expectations, and my new roof looks fantastic.

reviews_verbatim.author: MG TV
reviews_verbatim.quote: These guys are awesome!! They were very quick, did good work, and gave a very fair price. Highly recommend!

reviews_note: Google Maps' own unauthenticated view of this listing does not expose a Reviews tab or inline review text (confirmed live this session), so verbatim quotes were sourced from a third-party aggregator that scraped the same Google Business Profile (matching address exactly). Only 2 distinct quotes found after an exhaustive search (a 3rd result was a duplicate of the MG TV quote); used as-is rather than padded or invented, per DESIGN.md guidance to show fewer than 3 if that's all that exists.

photos_downloaded_and_curation.note: Google Maps' photo carousel for this listing (30 photos pulled via arrow-key cycling) is visibly a mixed pool: alongside real Gainesville-consistent job photos (oak trees with Spanish moss, no palms, modest ranch/farmhouse architecture) it also contains clear stock/unrelated content: a pure product catalog shot of a metal panel on a white background, a shingle-color swatch close-up, an unrelated commercial warehouse roof, a dumpster branded with a different company's name and phone number ('LD Construction & Kitchens'), and several South Florida palm-lined canal/golf-course scenes inconsistent with Gainesville. Only photos visually and geographically consistent with a real Gainesville job, showing genuine in-progress or finished roofing/gutter work with no text overlays, no competing branding, and no stock/product-catalog look, were used. One photo (a self-made Instagram-style ad graphic reading 'STORM DAMAGE' with the business's own blue/green chevron logo and www.352sroofing.com) confirmed the brand's own marketing material and logo colors but was excluded from the gallery for having a text overlay, per the visual curation gate.
